title: Velveting Chicken
steps: Scale the recipe to the desired quantity of chicken.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Mix all ingredients and marinate for 18 minutes.
Either parboil for 1 minute, or rinse off the marinade, pat dry, and stir-fry.
reviewFlags: The source presents parboiling and rinsing as alternatives but does not explain whether parboiled chicken should also be rinsed or how it should be finished.
headnote: Draft: Confirm the parboiling and finishing directions.
